planner.empty: Nothing scheduled today — enjoy your free time.
planner.overdue_header: Heads up: these items were due to start already but aren't marked done — double-check whether you missed them:
planner.risk_header: Suggestion: these tasks may not finish before their deadline — consider rescheduling or splitting them:
planner.gap_hint: Tip: you have about {minutes} minutes of contiguous free time today — good for important but non-urgent work.
agent.empty_input: Say something like "meeting tomorrow 3pm for 1 hour, high priority".
agent.llm_no_key: No LLM API key configured (SCHEDULE_LLM_API_KEY or config.llm_api_key)
agent.llm_error:
⚠️ The language model is unavailable, so this message was not processed.
Reason: {reason}
Check SCHEDULE_LLM_API_KEY, your network, and your account balance.
(If you really need keyword-rule fallback while offline, set SCHEDULE_USE_RULE_FALLBACK=1 and restart.)
agent.not_add_intent: This was understood as "{intent}", not a new task. Just send it in chat and I'll handle that action.
agent.added_future: Added "{title}" (not today — saved as a to-do).
agent.added_recurring: Added recurring task "{title}" (rule: {rule}); today's instance was created and the day re-planned.
agent.added_recurring_future: Added recurring task "{title}" (rule: {rule}); no match today, so instances will be created on matching days.
agent.duplicate_task: A similar task "{title}" already exists for today. Please confirm if you want to add a duplicate.
agent.marked_done: Marked "{title}" as done and re-planned today's schedule.
agent.deleted_recurring: Deleted recurring task "{title}" and its future instances.
agent.ask_when_modify: What time should it move to? e.g. "move study to 11am".
agent.ask_which_task: Which item should I change? Give me its name, e.g. "move study to 11am" — or ask for today's schedule first to see what's there.
agent.modify_not_found:
No task matching "{hint}".
Ask for today's schedule to see what's there, then say e.g. "move study to 11am".
agent.modify_nothing_found: Nothing to update (it may have been deleted already).
agent.priority_changed: Set {names} to "{priority}" priority{tail}, and re-planned today's schedule.
agent.moved_today: Moved {names} to {when}{priority_note}, and re-planned today's schedule.
agent.moved_future: Moved {names} to {when}{priority_note} (not today — saved as a to-do).
agent.demo_done: Sample data added. Ask for today's schedule to see it.
agent.need_title_or_time:
I'm not sure what task to record.
Include an item and a time, e.g. "meeting tomorrow 10am" or "gym Friday 45 min".
agent.need_task_ref_done: Tell me the task number or name, e.g. "done 3" or "done standup".
agent.need_task_ref_remove: Tell me the task number or name, e.g. "delete 3" or "delete brunch".
agent.need_done_ref: Which task is done? Give me its number or name, e.g. "done 3" or "done standup".
agent.need_remove_ref: Which task should I delete? Give me its number or name, e.g. "delete 3" or "delete brunch".
agent.unknown_intent:
I couldn't tell what action you want{detail}.
Try something like: `meeting tomorrow 10am`, `move study to 11am`, `set ai-dev to high priority`, `done 3`, `today's schedule`.
agent.priority_not_found:
No task matching "{hint}".
Ask for today's schedule first to see what's there.
agent.ask_which_priority: Which task should get high priority? e.g. "set study to high priority".
agent.non_task_hint:
I didn't treat that as a new task — it reads like a question or a change to something existing.
You can say:
- Add: `meeting tomorrow 3pm for 1 hour, high`
- Reschedule: `move study to 11am`, `move brunch to 3pm`
- Done/delete: `done 3`, `delete brunch`
- View: `today's schedule`, `list tasks`
api.user_exists: User already exists or the input is invalid: {err}
api.missing_token: Missing API token. Call POST /api/auth/register or POST /api/auth/login to get an api_key, then send Authorization: Bearer <api_key> (?token= also works for SSE/WS).
api.admin_header_required: When using the admin key you must include an X-User-Id header naming the target user.
api.admin_disabled: Admin key is disabled (config admin_api_key is empty).
api.auth_bad_user: Invalid username (letters, digits, underscore or hyphen; 2-32 characters).
channel.non_text_hint: Text messages only for now — just say "meeting tomorrow 10am" 🙂
channel.no_sender: The message has no sender id

ui.login_intro:
### Sign up / Sign in
Pick any username (a new one registers automatically); **password is optional**.
Each username is a separate, isolated schedule; signing in again with the same name returns to the same data.

Backend: `{url}`
